description:
Saves the advanced settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. time_zone must be one of time_zones, otherwise the answer is 400, and it applies after a container restart (it shows in restart_pending until then). The other two apply on save.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

requestBody.description: The settings to change; fields you leave out keep their value

config_beautifier.description: Format the generated nginx configs (env DISABLE_NGINX_BEAUTIFIER, inverted)

gravatar.description: Fetch Gravatar profile pictures, sends a hash of the email address to Gravatar (env DISABLE_GRAVATAR, inverted)

time_zone.description: Time zone of the container, one of time_zones (env TZ); applies after a container restart

200.description: The advanced settings after the save, in the same form as the GET answer
